claim_summary: VeriTime contributes a process-verifiable time series reasoning dataset (TSRgen/TSRBench with a six-step CoT) and difficulty-scheduled SFT and GRPO training with process rewards to improve LLM reasoning.

claim_evidence.quote: In this work, we propose VeriTime, a time series reasoning framework that enhances LLMs’ TS reasoning capabilities through process-verifiable reasoning data synthesis and tailored RL effectively exploiting time series-specific intermediate learning signals from the generated data.

modules.name: TSRgen process-verifiable reasoning dataset with six-step temporal CoT
modules.scope_reason: R2 places training data built to shape time series reasoning on the LLM side. The six-step CoT is the template TSRgen uses to generate trajectories and the structure that the process-level labels and rewards attach to; it is not a deployed runtime procedure and only functions together with the dataset, so it is merged here rather than split as a Harness module. Task coverage is not a Harness layer claim.

evidence.quote: In conclusion, the TSRgen is an automated TS-text dataset synthesis pipeline that integrates diverse reasoning tasks within a structured, TS–tailored reasoning dataset, named as TSRBench.
TSRgen constructs a TS-tailored reasoning process with six logically ordered steps illustrated in Figure 1.

Verifiable Process Annotation Extraction. To facilitate Reinforcement Learning (RL) for improving LLM time series reasoning performance, both the final label and the effective supervision of intermediate reasoning steps are crucial.

modules.name: Difficulty-scheduled SFT and reinforcement fine-tuning
modules.scope_reason: R2 places SFT and RL that update model parameters on the LLM side. Scheduling assigns samples to SFT or GRPO based on difficulty, while process rewards supervise reasoning; it is not a deployment workflow or trained tool-selection policy.

evidence.quote: The training process consists of two stages, corresponding to the two subsets defined above.
we propose a selective RFT data rollout strategy that identifies learnable and representative samples based on the difficulty hierarchy of TSRBench

Reliable intermediate reasoning steps are crucial for interpretable time series reasoning. To comprehensively assess the quality of the LLM reasoning trajectory, we further introduce four process-level rewards aligned with the TS-tailored reasoning steps.

adjudication.summary: The proposed GTS six-step CoT module was rejected and merged into the training-data module, leaving two LLM-side modules. Other fields of the candidate were accepted.
